title: Festivals and free time
description: Spring Festival with the grandparents, good wishes, performances and photos, hobbies, sport and the wider world.

sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié kuàilè!
sentences.english: Happy Spring Festival!

sentences.pinyin: Zhù nín shēntǐ jiànkāng!
sentences.english: Wishing you good health!

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶，春节快乐！祝您身体健康！
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai, Chūnjié kuàilè! Zhù nín shēntǐ jiànkāng!
sentences.english: Happy Spring Festival, Grandma! Wishing you good health!

sentences.pinyin: Zhù nǐ xīnnián kuàilè!
sentences.english: Happy New Year!

sentences.hanzi: 谢谢！米格，你来了我们特别高兴。
sentences.pinyin: Xièxie! Mǐgé, nǐ lái le wǒmen tèbié gāoxìng.
sentences.english: Thank you! 米格, we're so happy you came.

sentences.hanzi: 是啊，春节是中国最重要的节日。
sentences.pinyin: Shì a, Chūnjié shì Zhōngguó zuì zhòngyào de jiérì.
sentences.english: Yes, Spring Festival is the most important holiday in China.

sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān jiā lǐ yǒu hěn duō kèrén!
sentences.english: There are lots of guests here today!

sentences.pinyin: Yéye nǎinai yě lái le.
sentences.english: Grandpa and Grandma are here too.

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶是爸爸的妈妈，姥姥是妈妈的妈妈。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shì bàba de māma, lǎolao shì māma de māma.
sentences.english: 奶奶 is Dad's mother; 姥姥 is Mum's mother.

sentences.hanzi: 我们要好好照顾爷爷奶奶。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yào hǎohǎo zhàogu yéye nǎinai.
sentences.english: We should take good care of Grandpa and Grandma.

sentences.pinyin: Xièxie nín zhàogu wǒ.
sentences.english: Thank you for looking after me.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上我们一起看电视节目。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒmen yìqǐ kàn diànshì jiémù.
sentences.english: In the evening we watch TV together.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上小雨给大家表演一个节目。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang Xiǎoyǔ gěi dàjiā biǎoyǎn yí ge jiémù.
sentences.english: Tonight Xiaoyu will put on a show for everyone.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīng bu dào nǐ de shēngyīn.
sentences.english: I can't hear you.

sentences.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ dài le zhàoxiàngjī.
sentences.english: Great! I brought my camera.

sentences.pinyin: Hǎo! Dàjiā yìqǐ pāizhào ba!
sentences.english: Good! Let's all take a photo together!

sentences.pinyin: Tā jiějie xià ge yuè jiéhūn.
sentences.english: Her older sister is getting married next month.

sentences.pinyin: Bǐsài zài zhōumò jǔxíng.
sentences.english: The match is held at the weekend.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng cānjiā zhège bǐsài.
sentences.english: I want to take part in this competition.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme àihào?
sentences.english: What are your hobbies?

sentences.hanzi: 我的爱好是踢足球和画画。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de àihào shì tī zúqiú hé huà huà.
sentences.english: My hobbies are football and drawing.

sentences.hanzi: 我对中国历史很有兴趣。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì Zhōngguó lìshǐ hěn yǒu xìngqù.
sentences.english: I'm very interested in Chinese history.

sentences.pinyin: Háizimen zài wán yóuxì.
sentences.english: The kids are playing a game.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan shénme tǐyù yùndòng?
sentences.english: What sports do you like?

sentences.hanzi: 姥爷每天早上锻炼身体。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoye měitiān zǎoshang duànliàn shēntǐ.
sentences.english: Grandpa exercises every morning.

sentences.pinyin: Lǎoye gěi Xiǎoyǔ jiǎng gùshi.
sentences.english: Grandpa tells Xiaoyu a story.

sentences.hanzi: 我想去世界上很多国家旅游。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù shìjiè shàng hěn duō guójiā lǚyóu.
sentences.english: I want to travel to lots of countries around the world.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ qù guo jǐ ge guójiā?
sentences.english: How many countries have you been to?

exchanges.context: A friend wishes you a happy Spring Festival.
You're Grandma. 米格 has a camera and the whole family is here.
Grandma welcomes you warmly. Thank her for taking care of you.
You haven't travelled much yet, but you'd love to.

grammar.title: 祝: good wishes
grammar.body: 祝 + person + wish: 祝您身体健康 (good health, perfect for elders), 祝你新年快乐 (Happy New Year), 祝你生日快乐.

grammar.title: 奶奶 or 姥姥?
grammar.body: Chinese names grandparents by side: 爷爷, 奶奶 are Dad's parents; 姥爷, 姥姥 are Mum's parents (in the north; the south says 外公, 外婆).

grammar.title: 对…有兴趣
grammar.body: 对 + topic + 有兴趣: interested in. 我对中国历史很有兴趣. For hobbies: 我的爱好是….

grammar.title: Performing a 节目
grammar.body: At family gatherings, children often perform a 节目 (a song, a dance, a poem) for everyone. Watching it with a camera ready is part of the fun.

dialogue.title: Listening challenge: Spring Festival
dialogue.setting: New Year's Eve at her grandparents' home, full of relatives.

questions.q: What does 米格 wish Grandma?
Why are there so many people?
